DocAligner LCNet100 heatmap model and adapted postprocess
========================================================

Upstream license: Apache License 2.0
Upstream source: https://github.com/DocsaidLab/DocAligner
Pinned revision: 3275b0f07f8e99d8c01cb0774dea2549be1416b6
Checkpoint source: Google Drive file 1IlbLPkCv-TdaBLOPh_4J97P1_KHYYJ7a

Local modifications: OpenScaner invokes the pinned ONNX checkpoint directly
with ONNX Runtime's CPUExecutionProvider. The preprocessing and adapted
postprocess preserve upstream BGR CHW /255 input, 0.3 heatmap cutoff, uint8
conversion, Otsu binarization, and largest-polygon centroid semantics while
adding model-integrity, output-schema, provider, and quadrilateral validation.

The upstream repository provides the standard Apache License 2.0 text and no
separate copyright line. Its verbatim license text is packaged at
licenses/Apache-2.0.txt.
